parameters.name: Accessibility
parameters.description:
Visibility of the connection. Valid values:

- PUBLIC: visible to all workspace members.

- PRIVATE: visible only to the creator.

parameters.name: ConnectionIds
parameters.description: List of connection IDs to filter by.

parameters.name: ConnectionTypes
parameters.description: List of connection types to filter by.

parameters.name: Creator
parameters.description: Alibaba Cloud account ID of the creator.

parameters.name: EncryptOption
parameters.description:
Encryption option for sensitive fields in the response. Valid values:

- PlainText: returns values in plaintext.

- Secret: returns values in ciphertext.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries per page.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: Model identifier. Filters connections associated with this model.

parameters.name: ModelTypes
parameters.description: List of model types to filter by.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that marks the starting position for the next page of results.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
Sort order. Use with the SortBy parameter. Valid values:

- ASC: ascending order.

- DESC (default): descending order.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
Field by which to sort results. Default value: GmtCreateTime. Valid values:

- GmtCreateTime (default): sorts by creation time.

parameters.name: ToolCall
parameters.description:
Whether tool calling is supported. Valid values:

- true: supported.

- false: not supported.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace ID. You can call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.
